text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki brilliantly secured 1st
place 
in the Arima Kinen. However...
the crowd's 
eyes remained fixed upon Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is hailed as the representative 
of her generation, and the crowd praises 
only Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nobody mentions Yaeno Muteki's name. That 
angered her. She believed the true 
representatives of their generation were 
those who fought through the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then,
she would defeat Oguri Cap and prove 
that their generation carries the future. 
That was the "obsession" Yaeno Muteki 
displayed.
